exposure: antenatal common mental disorders (depression and anxiety disorder)
cohort: 545 participants from an inner-city London maternity population
finding: Severe fear of childbirth (FOC) was estimated to affect around 3% of the study population and was significantly associated with antenatal depression and anxiety.
mod_finding: There was a weak association between severe FOC and elective cesarean birth.
gest_age: Mean gestation: 14 weeks at first antenatal appointment, FOC measured at approximately 28 weeks gestation
